Market today: The 2-year yield jumping to its highest since January 2025 on a hot jobs report is the real driver, signaling potential Fed rate hikes and pressuring growth names. This mood hurts your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL/TRIM candidate, down 53.92%, and its leveraged nature amplifies risk. SPAL is also a concern, down 33.48%.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor sector's reaction to the broader market sentiment and any specific news.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for signs of capitulation or stabilization in tech.
plays: Trim SOXL: Its 53.92% loss and leveraged decay are significant risks. Consider reducing exposure.
Consider SPAL: Down 33.48%, this leveraged ETF also carries high risk. Evaluate its position.
No new buys today - hold and watch
